title: PRAY, always pray, the Holy Spirit pleads

lines.text: PRAY, always pray, the Holy Spirit pleads
Within thee all my daily hourly needs,
Pray. always pray, beneath sins heaviest loads
Prayer sees the blood from Jesus side that flowed.
Pray always pray, though weary, faint and lone
Prayer nestles by the Father’s sheltering throne.
Pray always pray; amid the world's turmoil
Prayer keep the heart at rest and nerves for toil.
Pray always pray; if joy thy pathway throng
Prayer strikes the harp, and sing the Angel's song
Pray always pray; if loved ones pass the veil
Prayer drinks with them of springs that can not fail.
All earthly things with earth shall fade away
Prayer grapes eternity: pray, always pray.
